SELECT 
  cd_gender, 
  cd_marital_status, 
  cd_education_status, 
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1, 
  cd_purchase_estimate, 
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2, 
  cd_credit_rating, 
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3 
FROM 
  customer c 
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
WHERE 
  ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME') 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3) AS d 
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    WHERE store_sales.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  ) 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM web_sales 
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3) AS d 
    ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    WHERE web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  ) 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM catalog_sales 
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3) AS d 
    ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    WHERE catalog_sales.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  ) 
GROUP BY 
  cd_gender, 
  cd_marital_status, 
  cd_education_status, 
  cd_purchase_estimate, 
  cd_credit_rating 
ORDER BY 
  cd_gender, 
  cd_marital_status, 
  cd_education_status, 
  cd_purchase_estimate, 
  cd_credit_rating 
LIMIT 100
